articles.title: Microsoft thinks its new Copilot ‘super app’ will be as influential as Office
articles.description: After teasing its new Copilot "super app" last month, Microsoft is officially unveiling it today. The redesigned Copilot app bundles three AI capabilities into a single interface of chat, coding, and agents. As part of the launch, Microsoft is also rebranding Scout, the AI personal assistant it unveiled at Build earlier this year, as Autopilot. […]

articles.title: Meta makes the Muse filesystem even more accessible
articles.description: Yesterday, with a little prodding, it was discovered that Meta's Muse would expose its filesystem to curious users. The files offered a fascinating peek under the hood of an AI chatbot, and appeared to expose details we weren't meant to see, not least because Muse itself told people, including us, it wasn't supposed to reveal […]

items.why_it_matters: 此举标志AI从工具向集成平台演进，可能重塑办公与开发工作流。

items.title: Meta makes the Muse filesystem even more accessible

items.why_it_matters: 模型内部细节泄露提示AI系统透明度风险，影响开发者对安全边界的判断。

items.title: Can Apple Home’s AI camera features outsmart Amazon’s and Google’s? I put them to the test

items.why_it_matters: 家庭安防领域AI能力对比凸显生态差异，影响消费者选择与厂商技术路线。
